name: ec_hr_appeal_decide
script:
# ec_hr_appeal_decide — HR MVP (2026-07-20). POST. Manager (reports_to) hoac HR duyet/tu choi appeal.
# Authz server-side truoc, ignore_permissions chi sau khi da xac thuc quan he manager/HR.
u = frappe.session.user
name = frappe.form_dict.get('name')
action = frappe.form_dict.get('action')
comment = frappe.form_dict.get('comment') or ''
if not name or action not in ('approve', 'reject'):
    frappe.throw('Thieu tham so')
ar = frappe.get_doc('Attendance Request', name)
cur = ar.get('ec_appeal_status') or 'Open'
if ar.docstatus != 0 or cur != 'Open':
    frappe.throw('Yeu cau da duoc xu ly')
mgr = frappe.db.get_value('Employee', ar.employee, 'reports_to')
mgr_user = None
if mgr:
    mgr_user = frappe.db.get_value('Employee', mgr, 'user_id')
hr_rows = frappe.db.sql("select 1 from `tabHas Role` where parent=%s and role in ('HR Manager','HR User')", (u,))
if u != mgr_user and (not hr_rows) and u != 'Administrator':
    frappe.throw('Ban khong co quyen duyet yeu cau nay')
ar.ec_appeal_status = 'Approved' if action == 'approve' else 'Rejected'
ar.ec_decided_by = u
ar.ec_decision_comment = comment
ar.flags.ignore_permissions = True
ar.save(ignore_permissions=True)
if action == 'approve':
    ar.submit()
trows = frappe.db.sql("select name from `tabToDo` where reference_type='Attendance Request' and reference_name=%s and status='Open'", (name,))
for t in trows:
    td = frappe.get_doc('ToDo', t[0])
    td.status = 'Closed'
    td.flags.ignore_permissions = True
    td.save(ignore_permissions=True)
frappe.response['message'] = {'status': ar.get('ec_appeal_status'), 'name': name, 'docstatus': ar.docstatus}

ec_hr_attendance_data
script:
# TEMP-WORKAROUND (2026-07-20, UAT-only): debug_as_user (SM-gated) PHAI GO truoc rollout.
# ec_hr_attendance_data — HR MVP. POST. Own-only calendar aggregate tu native sources.
u = frappe.session.user
dbg = frappe.form_dict.get('debug_as_user')
if dbg:
    is_sm = frappe.db.sql("select 1 from `tabHas Role` where parent=%s and role='System Manager'", (u,))
    if (not is_sm) and u != 'Administrator':
        frappe.throw('debug_as_user: System Manager only')
    u = dbg
if u == 'Guest':
    frappe.throw('Khong duoc phep')
emp = frappe.db.get_value('Employee', {'user_id': u, 'status': 'Active'}, ['name', 'employee_name', 'default_shift', 'holiday_list', 'company', 'reports_to'], as_dict=True)
if not emp:
    frappe.throw('Khong tim thay ho so nhan vien cho tai khoan nay. Lien he HR.')
# ec-att-member-v1: xem lich cong cua NGUOI TRONG NHOM. Lead xem duoc ca nhanh
# duoi minh (subtree lft/rgt), HR/System Manager xem duoc toan cong ty.
member = frappe.form_dict.get('member')
if member and member != emp.name:
    tgt = frappe.db.get_value('Employee', member, ['name', 'employee_name', 'default_shift', 'holiday_list', 'company', 'reports_to', 'lft', 'rgt'], as_dict=True)
    if not tgt:
        frappe.throw('Khong tim thay nhan vien')
    hr = frappe.db.sql("select 1 from `tabHas Role` where parent=%s and role in ('HR Manager','HR User','System Manager') limit 1", (u,))
    can = bool(hr) or (u == 'Administrator')
    if not can:
        me2 = frappe.db.get_value('Employee', emp.name, ['lft', 'rgt'], as_dict=True)
        if me2 and me2.lft is not None and tgt.lft is not None and tgt.lft > me2.lft and tgt.rgt < me2.rgt:
            can = True
    if not can:
        frappe.throw('Ban khong co quyen xem lich cong cua nguoi nay')
    emp = tgt
month = frappe.form_dict.get('month') or frappe.utils.nowdate()[:7]
if len(month) != 7 or month[4:5] != '-':
    frappe.throw('month sai dinh dang (YYYY-MM)')
start = month + '-01'
end = str(frappe.utils.get_last_day(start))
shift_name = emp.default_shift or 'EC Standard 9-18'
shift = frappe.db.get_value('Shift Type', shift_name, ['ec_checkin_cutoff', 'start_time', 'end_time'], as_dict=True)
cutoff = '10:00:00'
if shift and shift.ec_checkin_cutoff:
    cutoff = str(shift.ec_checkin_cutoff)
if len(cutoff) == 7:
    cutoff = '0' + cutoff
hl = emp.holiday_list
if not hl:
    hl = frappe.db.get_value('Company', emp.company, 'default_holiday_list')
hol = []
if hl:
    hrows = frappe.db.sql('select holiday_date, description, weekly_off from `tabHoliday` where parent=%s and holiday_date between %s and %s', (hl, start, end))
    hol = [{'d': str(r[0]), 'desc': r[1], 'wo': r[2]} for r in hrows]
arows = frappe.db.sql('select attendance_date, status, late_entry, early_exit, ec_late_status from `tabAttendance` where employee=%s and attendance_date between %s and %s and docstatus < 2', (emp.name, start, end))
atts = [{'d': str(r[0]), 's': r[1], 'le': r[2], 'ee': r[3], 'ls': r[4] or ''} for r in arows]
lrows = frappe.db.sql("select from_date, to_date, leave_type from `tabLeave Application` where employee=%s and docstatus=1 and status='Approved' and from_date<=%s and to_date>=%s", (emp.name, end, start))
leaves = [{'f': str(r[0]), 't': str(r[1]), 'type': r[2]} for r in lrows]
crows = frappe.db.sql("select date(time), min(time) from `tabEmployee Checkin` where employee=%s and log_type='IN' and date(time) between %s and %s group by date(time)", (emp.name, start, end))
cis = [{'d': str(r[0]), 't': str(r[1])[11:19]} for r in crows]
prows = frappe.db.sql("select name, from_date, to_date, docstatus, ifnull(ec_appeal_status,'Open'), ifnull(explanation,'') from `tabAttendance Request` where employee=%s and from_date<=%s and to_date>=%s and docstatus<2", (emp.name, end, start))
appeals = [{'name': r[0], 'f': str(r[1]), 't': str(r[2]), 'ds': r[3], 'st': r[4], 'note': r[5]} for r in prows]
pending = []
mrows = frappe.db.sql("select ar.name, ar.employee, ar.employee_name, ar.from_date, ar.explanation from `tabAttendance Request` ar join `tabEmployee` e on e.name=ar.employee where e.reports_to=%s and ar.docstatus=0 and ifnull(ar.ec_appeal_status,'Open')='Open' order by ar.creation desc limit 30", (emp.name,))
pending = [{'name': r[0], 'emp': r[1], 'emp_name': r[2], 'd': str(r[3]), 'note': r[4] or ''} for r in mrows]
lprows = frappe.db.sql("select a.name, a.employee, a.employee_name, a.attendance_date, ifnull(a.ec_late_reason,''), ifnull(a.late_entry,0), ifnull(a.early_exit,0) from `tabAttendance` a join `tabEmployee` e on e.name=a.employee where e.reports_to=%s and a.docstatus<2 and ifnull(a.ec_late_status,'')='Open' order by a.attendance_date desc limit 30", (emp.name,))
late_pending = [{'name': r[0], 'emp': r[1], 'emp_name': r[2], 'd': str(r[3]), 'reason': r[4], 'late': r[5], 'early': r[6]} for r in lprows]
hrows2 = []
if hl:
    hrows2 = frappe.db.sql("select holiday_date, description from `tabHoliday` where parent=%s and holiday_date > %s and ifnull(weekly_off,0)=0 order by holiday_date asc limit 3", (hl, frappe.utils.nowdate()))
upcoming = []
for r2 in hrows2:
    upcoming = upcoming + [{'d': str(r2[0]), 'desc': r2[1]}]
# ec-att-summary-v1: MOT dinh nghia 'ngay cong' cho ca hai trang.
# Truoc day trang chu tu dem D.checkins (so ngay CO check-in) con trang cham cong
# dem theo Attendance -> hai con so lech nhau (9 vs 1) tren cung mot thang. Payroll
# chay tren cong THUC, nen con so hien ra phai la con so C&B dung tinh luong.
#
# Cong duoc cong nhan = co ban ghi Attendance Present / Half Day, VA khong con
# di muon / ve som chua duoc duyet. Dung nguyen quy tac classify() cua trang cham
# cong. Tinh o SERVER de khong con hai ban sao quy tac tren hai trang.
att_by_day = {}
for a2 in atts:
    att_by_day[a2['d']] = a2
hol_by_day = {}
for h2 in hol:
    hol_by_day[h2['d']] = h2
sum_present = 0
sum_working = 0
sum_missing = 0
dcur = start
while dcur <= end:
    if dcur not in hol_by_day:
        sum_working = sum_working + 1
        arow = att_by_day.get(dcur)
        if arow and arow['s'] in ('Present', 'Half Day'):
            flagged = (arow['le'] or arow['ee']) and arow['ls'] != 'Approved'
            if flagged:
                sum_missing = sum_missing + 1
            else:
                sum_present = sum_present + 1
        elif dcur < frappe.utils.nowdate():
            if dcur not in [l2['f'] for l2 in leaves]:
                sum_missing = sum_missing + 1
    dcur = frappe.utils.add_days(dcur, 1)
summary = {'present': sum_present, 'working_total': sum_working, 'missing': sum_missing}

frappe.response['message'] = {'employee': emp.name, 'employee_name': emp.employee_name, 'month': month, 'start': start, 'end': end, 'cutoff': cutoff, 'today': frappe.utils.nowdate(), 'holidays': hol, 'attendance': atts, 'leaves': leaves, 'checkins': cis, 'appeals': appeals, 'pending_approvals': pending, 'late_pending': late_pending, 'upcoming_holidays': upcoming, 'summary': summary}

name: ec_hr_checkin
script:
# ec_hr_checkin — debug params removed 2026-08-11 (pre-payroll rollout).
# ec_hr_checkin — HR MVP V1. POST only. Idempotent self check-in. Raw Checkin FIRST -> policy SECOND.
u = frappe.session.user
if u == 'Guest':
    frappe.throw('Không được phép')
emp = frappe.db.get_value('Employee', {'user_id': u, 'status': 'Active'}, ['name', 'employee_name', 'default_shift', 'holiday_list', 'company'], as_dict=True)
if not emp:
    frappe.throw('Không tìm thấy hồ sơ nhân viên cho tài khoản này. Liên hệ HR.')
shift_name = emp.default_shift or 'EC Standard 9-18'
shift = frappe.db.get_value('Shift Type', shift_name, ['name', 'ec_checkin_cutoff'], as_dict=True)
cutoff = '10:00:00'
if shift and shift.ec_checkin_cutoff:
    cutoff = str(shift.ec_checkin_cutoff)
if len(cutoff) == 7:
    cutoff = '0' + cutoff
today = frappe.utils.nowdate()
now_dt = frappe.utils.now_datetime()
# Cua so cham cong SOM NHAT = start_time - begin_check_in_before_shift_start_time (cau hinh o Shift Type,
# khong hardcode). Chan cham cong luc 0h-5h sang.
sh2 = frappe.db.get_value('Shift Type', shift_name, ['start_time', 'begin_check_in_before_shift_start_time'], as_dict=True)
if sh2 and sh2.start_time:
    st = str(sh2.start_time)
    if len(st) == 7:
        st = '0' + st
    open_min = (int(st[0:2]) * 60 + int(st[3:5])) - int(sh2.begin_check_in_before_shift_start_time or 0)
    now_min = now_dt.hour * 60 + now_dt.minute
    if now_min < open_min:
        oh = ('0' + str(open_min // 60))[-2:]
        om = ('0' + str(open_min % 60))[-2:]
        frappe.throw('Chưa đến giờ chấm công. Hệ thống nhận chấm công từ ' + oh + ':' + om + ' hằng ngày.')
hl = emp.holiday_list
if not hl:
    hl = frappe.db.get_value('Company', emp.company, 'default_holiday_list')
is_holiday = False
holiday_desc = ''
if hl:
    hrow = frappe.db.sql('select description from `tabHoliday` where parent=%s and holiday_date=%s', (hl, today))
    if hrow:
        is_holiday = True
        holiday_desc = hrow[0][0]
on_leave = False
lrow = frappe.db.sql("select name from `tabLeave Application` where employee=%s and status='Approved' and docstatus=1 and %s between from_date and to_date", (emp.name, today))
if lrow:
    on_leave = True
existing = frappe.db.sql("select name, time from `tabEmployee Checkin` where employee=%s and log_type='IN' and date(time)=%s order by time asc limit 1", (emp.name, today))
att = frappe.db.sql('select name, status, docstatus from `tabAttendance` where employee=%s and attendance_date=%s and docstatus < 2', (emp.name, today))
result = {}
if existing:
    result['status'] = 'already'
    result['checkin_time'] = str(existing[0][1])
else:
    ci = frappe.get_doc({'doctype': 'Employee Checkin', 'employee': emp.name, 'log_type': 'IN', 'time': now_dt, 'shift': shift_name})
    ci.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    result['status'] = 'checked_in'
    result['checkin_time'] = str(now_dt)
first_time = result['checkin_time']
if len(first_time) > 8:
    first_time = first_time[11:19]
valid = first_time <= cutoff
if is_holiday:
    result['day_status'] = 'Holiday'
    result['note'] = holiday_desc
elif on_leave:
    result['day_status'] = 'On Leave'
elif att:
    result['day_status'] = att[0][1]
elif valid:
    ad = frappe.get_doc({'doctype': 'Attendance', 'employee': emp.name, 'attendance_date': today, 'status': 'Present', 'shift': shift_name, 'company': emp.company})
    ad.flags.ignore_permissions = True
    ad.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    ad.submit()
    result['day_status'] = 'Present'
else:
    result['day_status'] = 'Late'
result['cutoff'] = cutoff
result['date'] = today
result['employee'] = emp.name
frappe.response['message'] = result

script:
# ec_hr_confirm_credit — HR bam nut khi nhan vien len chinh thuc: cong don 1.25 x so-thang-thu-viec + set Full-time.
# param employee, months (2 hoac 3, mac dinh 2), dry=1 xem truoc.
u = frappe.session.user
emp_id = frappe.form_dict.get('employee')
months = frappe.form_dict.get('months')
dry = frappe.form_dict.get('dry')
if not emp_id:
    frappe.throw('Thieu employee')
mm = 2
if months:
    mm = int(months)
if mm < 1 or mm > 6:
    frappe.throw('So thang thu viec khong hop le (1-6)')
hr = frappe.db.sql("select 1 from `tabHas Role` where parent=%s and role in ('HR Manager','HR User')", (u,))
if (not hr) and u != 'Administrator':
    frappe.throw('Chi HR moi duoc thao tac')
emp = frappe.db.get_value('Employee', emp_id, ['employee_name'], as_dict=True)
if not emp:
    frappe.throw('Khong tim thay nhan vien')
existing = frappe.db.get_value('Leave Allocation', {'employee': emp_id, 'leave_type': 'Annual Leave', 'docstatus': 1}, 'name')
if existing:
    frappe.throw('Nhan vien nay da co quy phep (da cong don truoc do).')
amt = mm * 1.25
year = frappe.utils.nowdate()[:4]
if not dry:
    alloc = frappe.get_doc({'doctype': 'Leave Allocation', 'employee': emp_id, 'leave_type': 'Annual Leave', 'from_date': year + '-01-01', 'to_date': year + '-12-31', 'new_leaves_allocated': amt})
    alloc.flags.ignore_permissions = True
    alloc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    alloc.submit()
    frappe.db.set_value('Employee', emp_id, 'employment_type', 'Full-time')
frappe.response['message'] = {'employee': emp_id, 'employee_name': emp.employee_name, 'months': mm, 'credited': amt, 'dry': 1 if dry else 0}

name: ec_hr_double_day
script:
# [GUARD 2026-08-14, chat payroll] API cong phep = tien -> chi HR/CnB duoc goi thu cong.
u = frappe.session.user
if not u or u == 'Guest':
    frappe.throw('Khong duoc phep')
okrole = frappe.db.sql("select 1 from `tabHas Role` where parent=%s and parenttype='User' and role in ('HR Manager','HR User','EC CnB','System Manager')", (u,))
if u != 'Administrator' and not okrole:
    frappe.throw('Chi HR/CnB moi duoc chay cong phep thu cong')
# ec_hr_double_day — cong +2 Annual Leave cho nguoi trong 5 dept co cham cong ngay DD.MM (tu Q3). Idempotent theo from_date=ngay+leaves=2.
# param dry=1 = xem truoc khong ghi.
dry = frappe.form_dict.get('dry')
today = frappe.utils.nowdate()
year = today[:4]
year_end = year + '-12-31'
depts = ('Service - EC', 'E-commerce Operation - EC', 'Production - EC', 'Media - EC', 'Merchandise, Content & Design - EC')
credited = []
skipped = []
m = 7
while m <= 12:
    mm = ('0' + str(m))[-2:]
    dstr = year + '-' + mm + '-' + mm
    if dstr <= today:
        rows = frappe.db.sql("select distinct c.employee, e.employee_name from `tabEmployee Checkin` c inner join `tabEmployee` e on e.name = c.employee where date(c.time) = %s and e.status = 'Active' and e.department in %s", (dstr, depts))
        for r2 in rows:
            emp = r2[0]
            en = r2[1]
            alloc = frappe.db.get_value('Leave Allocation', {'employee': emp, 'leave_type': 'Annual Leave', 'docstatus': 1, 'from_date': ['<=', dstr], 'to_date': ['>=', dstr]}, 'name')
            if not alloc:
                skipped = skipped + [emp + '@' + dstr + ':no-alloc']
                continue
            ex = frappe.db.sql("select 1 from `tabLeave Ledger Entry` where employee=%s and leave_type='Annual Leave' and from_date=%s and leaves=2 and docstatus=1 limit 1", (emp, dstr))
            if ex:
                skipped = skipped + [emp + '@' + dstr + ':already']
                continue
            if not dry:
                led = frappe.get_doc({'doctype': 'Leave Ledger Entry', 'employee': emp, 'employee_name': en, 'leave_type': 'Annual Leave', 'transaction_type': 'Leave Allocation', 'transaction_name': alloc, 'leaves': 2, 'from_date': dstr, 'to_date': year_end})
                led.flags.ignore_permissions = True
                led.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
                led.submit()
            credited = credited + [emp + '@' + dstr]
    m = m + 1
frappe.response['message'] = {'today': today, 'dry': 1 if dry else 0, 'credited': credited, 'skipped_count': len(skipped)}

name: ec_hr_late_early_penalty
script:
# ec_hr_late_early_penalty - tru phep khi don DI TRE / VE SOM duoc duyet.
# DocType Event tren EC Approval Request (After Save).
#
# TAI SAO CONG DON THAY VI TRU NGAY:
#   ERPNext KHONG bieu dien duoc 0.25 hay 0.75 ngay trong don nghi phep -- chi
#   co nguyen ngay va nua ngay. Nen moi lan duyet chi cong vao 'so du tam' tren
#   ho so nhan vien (Employee.ec_late_early_bank). Khi so du tam cham 0.5 ngay
#   moi sinh MOT don nghi nua ngay THAT -- dung co che san co, so lieu luong
#   sach, bao cao phep khong lech.
#
# KHONG BAO GIO TRU HAI LAN:
#   ec_leave_penalty tren chinh don la dau moc, ghi TRUOC khi dong den so du.
#   After Save chay lai nhieu lan tren cung ban ghi; thieu chot nay la tru chong.
#
# KHI KHONG TAO DUOC DON NUA NGAY (vd ngay do da co don nghi khac):
#   so du tam GIU NGUYEN va ghi chu vao don. Khong mat phep, khong tru oan.
PENALTY_TYPE = 'Annual Leave'
biz = None
if doc.approval_type == 'LATE_EARLY_OUT' and doc.approval_status == 'Approved' and doc.reference_name:
    biz = frappe.db.get_value('EC Late Early Out Request', doc.reference_name,
        ['name','employee','request_type','applied_date','check_time','check_time_other','ec_leave_penalty'],
        as_dict=True)
if biz and biz.employee and not biz.ec_leave_penalty:
    ct = biz.check_time
    cto = biz.check_time_other
    rt = biz.request_type
    # --- BANG BAC TRU PHEP -----------------------------------------------------
    # Ca chuan EC Standard 9-18. Chinh sach cong ty 2026-08-21:
    #   duoi 2h -> 0.25 ngay | 2h den 4h -> 0.5 | tren 4h den 6h -> 0.75 | tren 6h -> 1
    #
    # Viet PHANG (khong dung def) la CO Y: sandbox cua DocType Event khong cho ham
    # nhin thay bien toan cuc cua chinh script -- dat trong def se NameError luc chay.
    #
    # Doan nay lap lai y het trong ec_hr_late_early_preview (Server Script khong
    # import duoc nhau). SUA MOT BEN THI SUA CA HAI.
    SHIFT_START = 9.0
    SHIFT_END = 18.0
    LATE = '\u0110i tr\u1ec5'
    EARLY = 'V\u1ec1 s\u1edbm'
    HOURS = {'10 AM':10.0,'11 AM':11.0,'12 PM':12.0,'1 PM':13.0,'2 PM':14.0,'3 PM':15.0,'4 PM':16.0,'5 PM':17.0}

    h = None
    t = (ct or '').strip()
    if t != 'Other':
        h = HOURS.get(t)
    else:
        raw = (cto or '').strip()
        low = raw.lower()
        nums = []
        cur = ''
        for ch in raw:
            if ch.isdigit():
                cur = cur + ch
            else:
                if cur:
                    nums.append(cur)
                cur = ''
        if cur:
            nums.append(cur)
        if nums:
            hh = int(nums[0][:2])
            mm = int(nums[1][:2]) if len(nums) > 1 else 0
            if mm > 59:
                mm = 0
            if 'pm' in low and hh < 12:
                hh = hh + 12
            if 'am' in low and hh == 12:
                hh = 0
            if hh <= 23:
                h = hh + (mm / 60.0)

    hrs = None
    pen = 0.0
    if h is not None:
        rts = (rt or '').strip()
        if rts == EARLY:
            hrs = SHIFT_END - h
        elif rts == LATE:
            hrs = h - SHIFT_START
        else:
            # ban ghi cu chua co request_type: doan theo gio, truoc 13h coi la di tre
            hrs = (h - SHIFT_START) if h < 13 else (SHIFT_END - h)
        hrs = round(hrs, 2)
        if hrs <= 0:
            pen = 0.0
        elif hrs < 2:
            pen = 0.25
        elif hrs <= 4:
            pen = 0.5
        elif hrs <= 6:
            pen = 0.75
        else:
            pen = 1.0

    if pen > 0:
        frappe.db.set_value('EC Late Early Out Request', biz.name, 'ec_leave_penalty', pen)
        bank = frappe.db.get_value('Employee', biz.employee, 'ec_late_early_bank') or 0
        bank = round(bank + pen, 2)
        note = 'Tru phep do di tre / ve som: ' + str(hrs) + 'h ngay ' + str(biz.applied_date) + ' (' + biz.name + ')'
        # Leave Application bat buoc co leave_approver. Don nay sinh ra SAU khi
        # quan ly da duyet don di tre/ve som, nen nguoi duyet chinh la quan ly do;
        # khong co reports_to thi lui ve HR Manager de don khong bi ket.
        mgr = frappe.db.get_value('Employee', biz.employee, 'reports_to')
        appr = frappe.db.get_value('Employee', mgr, 'user_id') if mgr else None
        if not appr:
            hrrow = frappe.db.sql("select parent from `tabHas Role` where role='HR Manager' and parenttype='User' limit 1")
            appr = hrrow[0][0] if hrrow else None
        guard = 0
        while bank >= 0.5 and guard < 8:
            guard = guard + 1
            try:
                la = frappe.get_doc({'doctype': 'Leave Application',
                    'employee': biz.employee, 'leave_type': PENALTY_TYPE,
                    'from_date': biz.applied_date, 'to_date': biz.applied_date,
                    'half_day': 1, 'half_day_date': biz.applied_date,
                    'description': note, 'status': 'Approved',
                    'leave_approver': appr})
                la.flags.ignore_permissions = True
                la.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
                la.submit()
                bank = round(bank - 0.5, 2)
            except Exception as e:
                frappe.get_doc('EC Late Early Out Request', biz.name).add_comment('Comment',
                    'Chua tao duoc don tru nua ngay phep: ' + str(e)[:180] +
                    ' -- giu nguyen so du tam ' + str(bank) + ' ngay, se thu lai lan sau.')
                break
        frappe.db.set_value('Employee', biz.employee, 'ec_late_early_bank', bank)

name: ec_hr_leave_apply
script:
# ec_hr_leave_apply - nhan vien nop don nghi phep cho chinh minh.
#
# BA LUAT NGHIEP VU o day, moi luat mot ly do:
#
# 1) NGHI OM (ec-lv-sick-doc-v1): duoc xin lui ngay toi da SICK_BACKDATE_DAYS
#    ngay -- nguoi om that thuong khong kip nop don truoc -- nhung BAT BUOC
#    dinh kem chung tu. Chung tu phai la File DO CHINH nguoi nop tao ra: neu
#    chi tin file_url client gui len thi ai cung gan duoc giay to cua nguoi
#    khac vao don minh.
#
# 2) NGHI BU OT (ec-lv-comp-v1): bat buoc chon NGAY DA OT. Ngay do phai o qua
#    khu, trong vong COMP_LOOKBACK_DAYS ngay, PHAI CO dau vet cham cong that
#    (Employee Checkin hoac Attendance) va CHUA duoc dung cho don bu nao khac.
#    Khong co ba chot nay thi 'nghi bu' tro thanh phep khong gioi han.
#
# 3) HIEU / HI / THAI SAN (ec-lv-2step-v1): khong gioi han so ngay, nhung phai
#    qua HAI cua: HR duyet truoc, CEO duyet sau. Don sinh ra o giai doan 'hr'.
#    Cac loai con lai giu nguyen luong cu: quan ly truc tiep duyet mot lan.
SICK = 'Sick Leave'
SICK_BACKDATE_DAYS = 7
COMP = 'Compensatory Off'
COMP_LOOKBACK_DAYS = 90
TWO_STEP = ('Marriage Leave', 'Bereavement Leave', 'Maternity Leave', 'Paternity Leave')

u = frappe.session.user
if u == 'Guest':
    frappe.throw('Khong duoc phep')
emp = frappe.db.get_value('Employee', {'user_id': u, 'status': 'Active'}, ['name','employee_name','company','reports_to'], as_dict=True)
if not emp:
    frappe.throw('Khong tim thay ho so nhan vien')
lt = frappe.form_dict.get('leave_type')
fd = frappe.form_dict.get('from_date')
td = frappe.form_dict.get('to_date')
half = frappe.form_dict.get('half_day')
note = frappe.form_dict.get('reason') or ''
doc_url = (frappe.form_dict.get('attachment') or '').strip()
ot_date = (frappe.form_dict.get('ot_date') or '').strip()
if not lt or not fd or not td:
    frappe.throw('Thieu thong tin (loai phep / ngay)')
if td < fd:
    frappe.throw('Ngay ket thuc phai sau ngay bat dau')

today = frappe.utils.nowdate()
if fd < today:
    if lt != SICK:
        frappe.throw('Chi don nghi om moi duoc xin lui ngay. Truong hop khac vui long lien he Nhan su.')
    if frappe.utils.date_diff(today, fd) > SICK_BACKDATE_DAYS:
        frappe.throw('Don nghi om chi duoc xin lui toi da ' + str(SICK_BACKDATE_DAYS) + ' ngay. Qua han vui long lien he Nhan su.')

fdoc = None
if lt == SICK:
    if not doc_url:
        frappe.throw('Nghi om bat buoc dinh kem chung tu (giay kham benh / don thuoc).')
    fdoc = frappe.db.get_value('File', {'file_url': doc_url, 'owner': u}, ['name'], as_dict=True)
    if not fdoc:
        frappe.throw('Khong doc duoc chung tu dinh kem. Vui long tai len lai.')

if lt == COMP:
    if not ot_date:
        frappe.throw('Nghi bu bat buoc chon ngay ban da OT truoc do.')
    if ot_date >= today:
        frappe.throw('Ngay OT phai la ngay da qua.')
    if frappe.utils.date_diff(today, ot_date) > COMP_LOOKBACK_DAYS:
        frappe.throw('Chi xin bu cho ngay OT trong vong ' + str(COMP_LOOKBACK_DAYS) + ' ngay gan day.')
    ci = frappe.db.sql("select 1 from `tabEmployee Checkin` where employee=%s and date(time)=%s limit 1", (emp.name, ot_date))
    if not ci:
        ci = frappe.db.sql("select 1 from `tabAttendance` where employee=%s and attendance_date=%s and docstatus<2 limit 1", (emp.name, ot_date))
    if not ci:
        frappe.throw('He thong khong thay ban cham cong ngay ' + ot_date + '. Vui long chon dung ngay da OT hoac bao Nhan su.')
    # ec-lv-comp-v2: don da BI TU CHOI khong duoc giu ngay OT lam con tin. Truoc
    # day dieu kien chi loc docstatus<2, ma don Rejected van la docstatus=1,
    # nen ai bi tu choi mot lan la mat luon ngay OT do, khong xin bu lai duoc.
    dup = frappe.db.sql("select name from `tabLeave Application` where employee=%s and leave_type=%s and docstatus<2 and status != 'Rejected' and description like %s limit 1", (emp.name, COMP, '%[OT:' + ot_date + ']%'))
    if dup:
        frappe.throw('Ngay OT ' + ot_date + ' da duoc dung cho don ' + dup[0][0] + '.')
    note = ('[OT:' + ot_date + '] ' + note).strip()

ov = frappe.db.sql("select name from `tabLeave Application` where employee=%s and docstatus<2 and status in ('Open','Approved') and from_date<=%s and to_date>=%s limit 1", (emp.name, td, fd))
if ov:
    frappe.throw('Ban da co don nghi trung khoang ngay nay: ' + ov[0][0])

stage = ''
appr = None
if lt in TWO_STEP:
    stage = 'hr'
    hr_rows = frappe.db.sql("select parent from `tabHas Role` where role='HR Manager' and parenttype='User' limit 1")
    appr = hr_rows[0][0] if hr_rows else None
elif emp.reports_to:
    appr = frappe.db.get_value('Employee', emp.reports_to, 'user_id')

doc = {'doctype': 'Leave Application', 'employee': emp.name, 'leave_type': lt, 'from_date': fd, 'to_date': td, 'description': note, 'company': emp.company, 'status': 'Open', 'ec_approval_stage': stage}
if half:
    hd = frappe.form_dict.get('half_day_date') or fd
    if hd < fd or hd > td:
        hd = fd
    doc['half_day'] = 1
    doc['half_day_date'] = hd
if appr:
    doc['leave_approver'] = appr
la = frappe.get_doc(doc)
la.flags.ignore_permissions = True
la.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
if fdoc:
    f = frappe.get_doc('File', fdoc.name)
    f.attached_to_doctype = 'Leave Application'
    f.attached_to_name = la.name
    f.flags.ignore_permissions = True
    f.save(ignore_permissions=True)
# ec-lv-todo-v1: nguoi duyet phai duoc NHAC, khong phai tu mo trang di tim.
# Action Center chi doc ToDo dang Open -- khong co ToDo thi don nam im cho toi
# khi nguoi nop nhan tin hoi. resolvers.py dua Leave Application ve /ec-hr/leave
# va giu phan loai approval, nen the nay se nam trong nhom PHE DUYET.
# Loi tao ToDo KHONG duoc lam hong viec nop don: don da luu roi.
if appr:
    try:
        todo_doc = frappe.get_doc({
            'doctype': 'ToDo',
            'allocated_to': appr,
            'reference_type': 'Leave Application',
            'reference_name': la.name,
            'status': 'Open',
            'priority': 'Medium',
            'date': fd,
            'description': 'Duyet don nghi phep: ' + emp.employee_name + ' - ' + lt + ' (' + str(fd) + ' den ' + str(td) + ')'
        })
        todo_doc.flags.ignore_permissions = True
        todo_doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    except Exception as e:
        frappe.log_error(frappe.get_traceback(), 'ec_hr_leave_apply: khong tao duoc ToDo cho ' + la.name)

frappe.response['message'] = {'name': la.name, 'days': la.total_leave_days, 'status': 'Open', 'approver': appr, 'stage': stage}

else:

    if subs:

for t in trows:

script:
# ec_hr_leave_decide - duyet / tu choi don nghi phep.
#
# HAI LUONG, quyet dinh boi ec_approval_stage tren chinh don (ec-lv-2step-v1):
#
#   stage rong  -> luong cu, KHONG doi: quan ly truc tiep hoac HR duyet mot
#                  lan la xong.
#   stage 'hr'  -> hieu / hi / thai san. HR duyet -> don CHUA submit, chi
#                  chuyen sang 'ceo' va doi nguoi duyet sang CEO. Nhan vien
#                  van thay don o trang thai cho.
#   stage 'ceo' -> chi CEO (hoac Administrator) moi ket thuc duoc.
#
# Tu choi thi dung ngay o bat ky giai doan nao -- khong bat nguoi ta cho tiep.
#
# Vi sao doc stage TU DON chu khong tu loai phep: mot don da nop roi phai di
# het duong cu cua no, ke ca khi sau nay cong ty doi chinh sach loai phep do.
CEO_USER = 'lam.nguyen@ecentric.vn'

u = frappe.session.user
if u == 'Guest':
    frappe.throw('Khong duoc phep')
nm = frappe.form_dict.get('name')
action = frappe.form_dict.get('action')
if not nm or action not in ('approve','reject'):
    frappe.throw('Thieu tham so')
la = frappe.get_doc('Leave Application', nm)
if la.docstatus != 0:
    frappe.throw('Don nay da duoc xu ly')

is_admin = (u == 'Administrator')
hr = frappe.db.sql("select 1 from `tabHas Role` where parent=%s and role in ('HR Manager','HR User')", (u,))
is_hr = bool(hr)
is_ceo = (u == CEO_USER)
mgr = frappe.db.get_value('Employee', la.employee, 'reports_to')
mgr_user = frappe.db.get_value('Employee', mgr, 'user_id') if mgr else None
stage = (la.get('ec_approval_stage') or '').strip()
# ec-lv-ancestor-v1: cap tren GIAN TIEP trong cay bao cao (ancestor cua nguoi nghi)
# cung duyet/tu choi duoc, khong chi quan ly truc tiep. Van giu 'khong ai tu duyet don minh'.
is_ancestor_mgr = bool(frappe.db.sql("select 1 from `tabEmployee` mm, `tabEmployee` aa where mm.user_id=%s and aa.name=%s and aa.lft > mm.lft and aa.rgt < mm.rgt limit 1", (u, la.employee)))

# ec-lv-noself-v1: khong ai duyet don cua chinh minh, ke ca nguoi mang role HR
# hay nguoi tu bao cao len chinh minh. TU CHOI thi VAN cho: do la cach nhan vien
# rut lai don da nop, chan lai chi khien ho phai di nho nguoi khac huy ho.
# Administrator duoc mien de con duong go ket khi he thong ket.
applicant_user = frappe.db.get_value('Employee', la.employee, 'user_id')
if action == 'approve' and applicant_user and u == applicant_user and not is_admin:
    frappe.throw('Ban khong the tu duyet don nghi cua chinh minh. Vui long de quan ly truc tiep hoac Nhan su duyet.')

if action == 'reject':
    if not (is_admin or is_hr or is_ceo or u == mgr_user or is_ancestor_mgr):
        frappe.throw('Ban khong co quyen duyet don nay')
    la.status = 'Rejected'
    la.flags.ignore_permissions = True
    la.save(ignore_permissions=True)
    la.submit()
    frappe.response['message'] = {'name': nm, 'status': 'Rejected', 'stage': stage}
else:
    if stage == 'hr':
        if not (is_hr or is_admin):
            frappe.throw('Don nay cho Nhan su duyet truoc.')
        la.ec_approval_stage = 'ceo'
        la.leave_approver = CEO_USER
        la.flags.ignore_permissions = True
        la.save(ignore_permissions=True)
        la.add_comment('Comment', 'Nhan su da duyet. Chuyen CEO duyet buoc cuoi.')
        frappe.response['message'] = {'name': nm, 'status': 'Open', 'stage': 'ceo', 'next': 'CEO'}
    elif stage == 'ceo':
        # ec-lv-ceo-selfleave-v1: don hieu/hi cua CHINH CEO tung bi ket cung --
        # buoc cuoi bat buoc CEO duyet, ma CEO lai la nguoi nop nen chot chan tu
        # duyet chan lai, khong ai di tiep duoc tru Administrator. Truong hop do
        # chuyen quyen chot cho Nhan su: van la hai nguoi khac nhau ky, van giu
        # nguyen tac khong ai tu duyet don minh.
        if applicant_user == CEO_USER:
            if not (is_hr or is_admin):
                frappe.throw('Don nghi cua CEO: buoc cuoi do Nhan su duyet.')
        elif not (is_ceo or is_admin):
            frappe.throw('Don nay cho CEO duyet buoc cuoi.')
        la.status = 'Approved'
        la.flags.ignore_permissions = True
        la.save(ignore_permissions=True)
        la.submit()
        frappe.response['message'] = {'name': nm, 'status': la.status, 'stage': 'done'}
    else:
        if u != mgr_user and (not is_hr) and (not is_admin) and (not is_ancestor_mgr):
            frappe.throw('Ban khong co quyen duyet don nay')
        la.status = 'Approved'
        la.flags.ignore_permissions = True
        la.save(ignore_permissions=True)
        la.submit()
        frappe.response['message'] = {'name': nm, 'status': la.status, 'stage': ''}

# ec-lv-todo-close-v1: nhac viec phai TAT khi da xu ly. Action Center chi doc
# ToDo dang Open, nen khong dong thi don da duyet xong van treo vinh vien trong
# 'Viec can lam' cua nguoi duyet.
# Trang thai doc LAI TU DON chu khong tu frappe.response: don la su that duy nhat,
# va cach nay khong phu thuoc vao ngu nghia cua response trong Server Script.
try:
    la2 = frappe.get_doc('Leave Application', nm)
    stage_now = (la2.get('ec_approval_stage') or '').strip()
    status_now = la2.status
    # ec-lv-cc-lead-v1: don da duyet XONG -> bao CHO LEAD PHONG BAN (quan ly truc
    # tiep cua nguoi nghi). Chi thong bao (Notification Log, hien o chuong), khong
    # tao viec can lam; va CHI cap tren truc tiep -- khong bao len cap cao hon.
    if status_now == 'Approved' and mgr_user and mgr_user != applicant_user and mgr_user != u:
        note = frappe.get_doc({'doctype': 'Notification Log', 'for_user': mgr_user, 'from_user': applicant_user, 'type': 'Alert', 'document_type': 'Leave Application', 'document_name': nm, 'link': '/ec-hr/leave', 'subject': 'Nghỉ phép đã duyệt: ' + str(la2.employee_name or la2.employee) + ' (' + str(la2.from_date) + ' → ' + str(la2.to_date) + ')', 'email_content': 'Loại: ' + str(la2.leave_type) + ' · ' + str(la2.total_leave_days) + ' ngày'})
        note.flags.ignore_permissions = True
        note.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    olds = frappe.db.sql("select name from `tabToDo` where reference_type='Leave Application' and reference_name=%s and status='Open'", (nm,))
    for row in olds:
        tdoc = frappe.get_doc('ToDo', row[0])
        tdoc.status = 'Closed'
        tdoc.flags.ignore_permissions = True
        tdoc.save(ignore_permissions=True)
    # HR duyet xong -> don CHUA xong: chuyen nhac viec sang CEO. Khong mo ToDo moi
    # thi sau buoc HR don bien mat khoi man hinh moi nguoi du van dang cho.
    if status_now == 'Open' and stage_now == 'ceo':
        nt = frappe.get_doc({
            'doctype': 'ToDo',
            'allocated_to': CEO_USER,
            'reference_type': 'Leave Application',
            'reference_name': nm,
            'status': 'Open',
            'priority': 'Medium',
            'date': la2.from_date,
            'description': 'Duyet buoc cuoi (Nhan su da duyet): ' + str(la2.employee_name or la2.employee) + ' - ' + str(la2.leave_type)
        })
        nt.flags.ignore_permissions = True
        nt.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
except Exception as e:
    frappe.log_error(frappe.get_traceback(), 'ec_hr_leave_decide: ToDo housekeeping loi tren ' + str(nm))

# ec_hr_my_salary_slips — HR-5 HARDENED (H1, 2026-07-20). POST only. SELF-SERVICE ONLY.
# Target LUON resolve tu frappe.session.user -> Employee. KHONG doc employee/user/as/debug_as_user
# tu client — moi param identity bi ignore. CnB xem payroll nguoi khac qua native Desk (EC CnB Payroll).
# Administrator = unavoidable superuser boundary (bypass moi permission) — ghi nhan trong ledger.
u = frappe.session.user
if u == 'Guest':
    frappe.throw('Khong duoc phep')
emp = frappe.db.get_value('Employee', {'user_id': u, 'status': 'Active'}, ['name', 'employee_name'], as_dict=True)
if not emp:
    frappe.throw('Khong tim thay ho so nhan vien cho tai khoan nay.')
rows = frappe.db.sql("select name, start_date, end_date, total_working_days, payment_days, leave_without_pay, absent_days, gross_pay, total_deduction, net_pay, rounded_total, docstatus from `tabSalary Slip` where employee=%s and docstatus=1 order by start_date desc limit 24", (emp.name,))
slips = []
for r in rows:
    ded = frappe.db.sql("select salary_component, amount from `tabSalary Detail` where parent=%s and parentfield='deductions' order by idx", (r[0],))
    ear = frappe.db.sql("select salary_component, amount from `tabSalary Detail` where parent=%s and parentfield='earnings' order by idx", (r[0],))
    slips = slips + [{'name': r[0], 'start': str(r[1]), 'end': str(r[2]), 'working_days': r[3], 'payment_days': r[4], 'lwp': r[5], 'absent': r[6], 'gross': r[7], 'deduction': r[8], 'net': r[9], 'rounded': r[10], 'earnings': [{'c': e[0], 'a': e[1]} for e in ear], 'deductions': [{'c': d[0], 'a': d[1]} for d in ded]}]
frappe.response['message'] = {'employee': emp.name, 'employee_name': emp.employee_name, 'slips': slips}
